The section does not state a frequency or interval for fluoride varnish application; the measurement-year numerator window is an assumption, declared as derived, and needs human review.

The start of eligibility ('starting at the age of primary tooth eruption') depends on a dental finding that structured EHR data does not reliably hold. It is encoded as uncomputable, so the engine will report the denominator as not computable.
Age is evaluated at the end of the measurement year (max 4). Children who turn 5 during the year are excluded even though they were eligible for part of it.
The asterisk on the date 'December 2021 *' refers to a footnote that is not included in the section text, so it could not be represented.
The section does not address other parts of the full USPSTF topic, such as oral fluoride supplementation or caries screening. Nothing beyond the fluoride varnish statement was encoded.
The concept fluoride_varnish is used as a procedure.
